notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.5 Now Live
notes.notes: The Start button now plays the most recently unlocked level and the highest Star rating is saved instead of the most recent Star Rating on the Level Select. 4K resolution has also been disabled until a solution can be found for the visual bugs.

notes.title: Progress Update – Build Working on Steam!
notes.notes:
Quick update on Orbs Orbs Orbs! A build is now up and running on Steam, which is a pretty big step forward. However, I’ll need to wait about three weeks before I can get keys to you in order to showcase and test the game.

In the meantime, I’ll be polishing things up and making sure everything runs smoothly. Thanks for your patience—I can’t wait to share more with you soon!

Be sure to check out me making the game on Twitch here: https://www.twitch.tv/acrylic_pixel

Stay tuned!

Chris 

Acrylic Pixel Games
